answer: Cap each identity at 40 paid submissions per epoch and rotate the auditor pool every epoch, so a fake that slips past one set of graders meets a fresh set the next. Every identity posts a 400 POA bond locked 60 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication, so a dune of 1,000 fakes costs 400,000 POA upfront while the cap limits it to 40,000 paid submissions. A quartz clock in the public registry timestamps every attestation, and any island of identities sharing one funding source has its payouts frozen at the third duplicate reveal, verifiable by anyone in seconds.
